summary: Iteration 16: Customer data (section 1 of the contract) + PDF contract generation + email delivery of the signed PDF. ALL 18/18 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter16_customer_pdf.py (~2.5s under `-n 0`). Frontend validation verified via Playwright at 390x844. Backend live-HTTPS rejections (safe, pre-insert): (1) POST /api/bookings without customer -> 400 'Compila i dati per il contratto (codice fiscale e documento)'; (2) tax_code shorter than 11 chars -> 422; (3) doc_type='altro' -> 422 (Literal violated); (4) birth_date not YYYY-MM-DD -> 422; (5) GET /api/bookings/me returns [] after all rejections -> confirms NO booking was created. In-process ASGI success (httpx.ASGITransport on server.app, server.on_booking_confirmed monkeypatched to async no-op so NOTHING is written to the real Google Sheet or sent via Resend): fresh register -> POST /api/bookings {payment_method:'store', contract_accepted:true, clauses_approved:true, privacy_accepted:true, contract_version:<real>, customer:{full_name:'Mario Rossi', tax_code:'RSSMRA80A01L191X', birth_date:'1980-01-01', address:'Via Roma 10', city_zip:'Tolentino 62029', nationality:'Italiana', doc_type:'ci', doc_number:'AX1234567', doc_issuer_expiry:'Comune di Tolentino, 31/12/2030', emergency_contact:'Luigi Bianchi 333 1112222'}} -> 200; returned Booking has customer dict (tax_code uppercase preserved), contract_accepted_at ISO, contract_version real, status='confirmed', payment_status='to_pay_in_store'; on_booking_confirmed hook invoked exactly 1x. GET /api/me/customer returns the saved customer (tax_code='RSSMRA80A01L191X', birth_date='1980-01-01', doc_type='ci'). PDF authorization matrix for GET /api/bookings/{id}/contract.pdf: owner Bearer -> 200 application/pdf (%PDF header); admin Bearer -> 200; a DIFFERENT user's Bearer -> 404; ?t=contract_link_token(booking_id) -> 200 without auth; ?t=invalid -> 404; ?t=token-for-OTHER-booking -> 404; a contract link token used as Bearer on /api/auth/me -> 401 (current_user rejects tokens with purpose='contract'). PDF text (via pypdf) contains 'Mario Rossi', 'RSSMRA80A01L191X', 'ACCETTAZIONE ELETTRONICA IN APP' AND the acceptance date in DD/MM/YYYY (Europe/Rome). Mailer: mailer.booking_email(bk) HTML contains 'Scarica il contratto (PDF)' AND the signed download URL `/api/bookings/{id}/contract.pdf?t=<token>` AND the acceptance date (DD/MM/YYYY, Europe/Rome). mailer.contract_attachment(bk, lines) returns [{filename:'contratto-<...>.pdf', content:<base64 of %PDF...>}]. mailer._send_once(..., with_contract=True) correctly calls send_email with that attachments list (stub_send_email captured the payload; attachments[0] decoded to a real PDF; recipient matched the booking's user_email case-insensitive). FRONTEND (390x844, fresh TEST_iter16_fe_<hex>@example.com registered via page.evaluate fetch, token stored as JSON.stringify(token) under localStorage['auth_token']): bike card -> Scegli la taglia -> date (today+10) -> days-1 -> size-option-M -> book-now-button -> /checkout. On /checkout: [data-testid='customer-form'] renders with ALL expected testIDs present and non-missing: customer-full_name (prefilled with 'Mario Rossi' from user.name), customer-tax_code (auto-uppercase on input — typed 'rssmra80a01l191x' -> displayed 'RSSMRA80A01L191X'), customer-birth_date (placeholder 'GG/MM/AAAA'), customer-address, customer-city_zip (placeholder 'Tolentino 62029'), customer-nationality (default 'Italiana'), chips customer-doc-ci/-patente/-passaporto, customer-doc_number, customer-doc_issuer_expiry, customer-emergency_contact. [data-testid='customer-form-error'] is NOT visible before confirming (showErrors=false initially). After phone fill + contract accept, tapping [data-testid='confirm-booking-button'] with EMPTY/INVALID customer fields: (a) customer-form-error becomes visible with text 'Controlla i dati per il contratto evidenziati in rosso'; (b) invalid inputs get red border (computed borderColor on customer-tax_code: rgb(224, 53, 43) = theme error color); (c) toast appears; (d) GET /api/bookings/me returns [] BEFORE and AFTER the click -> NO booking was created, confirming the frontend short-circuits on customerErrors().length>0 (confirm() returns before POST /api/bookings). The final confirm with VALID data was intentionally NOT exercised (safety contract: writes to the user's real Google Sheet). Cleanup: 3 TEST_iter16 users deleted post-run; 0 TEST_iter16 bookings in Mongo at end (the ASGI test's booking was deleted by its own fixture teardown). No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.create_booking (server.py:427-463): guards ordered correctly — stripe-gate -> contract/consent -> contract version lookup -> customer presence -> bike availability. Note the customer-missing 400 fires BEFORE the DB insert / bike availability lookup, so there's zero side effect for the live rejection tests. The customer.model_dump() is wrapped in {k: v.strip() for k, v in ...}; good hygiene (prevents accidental leading/trailing spaces being persisted on-chain to the PDF).

server.CustomerIn (server.py:151-162): tax_code min_length=11 max_length=20 + Pydantic Literal for doc_type give clean 422s on invalid payloads. Field 'tax_code' uses only Field(min_length=11) — no regex — so a 11-char payload with special chars would currently pass server-side. The FRONTEND validator (`customerErrors` in CustomerForm.tsx:41-53) tightens this with `/^[A-Za-z0-9]{11,20}$/`. Consider mirroring that regex server-side (pattern=r'^[A-Za-z0-9]{11,20}$') as defense-in-depth. Not blocking today.

server.booking_contract_pdf (server.py:403-424): dual-auth (link token OR owner/admin bearer) is cleanly separated: when ?t= is present, we DO NOT call current_user (so expired login doesn't break the email link). Owner check uses `bk['user_id'] == user['id']`, admin check via role=='admin'. 404 for both the 'not allowed' and 'booking missing' cases — intentional (don't leak booking IDs). contract_link_token has 180-day expiry which matches the retention window.

server.current_user (server.py:220-221): rejects any token that has `purpose` set — this is the critical check that prevents a contract-download link token from being used as a login token (verified: /api/auth/me with a contract token returns 401). Good.

mailer.contract_url (mailer.py:180-186): returns '' if public_base is not https or contract_version is missing. The frontend already saves public_base at booking-insert time (public_base(request) reads x-forwarded-host) — relies on the ingress preserving that header. If the ingress is reconfigured without x-forwarded-host, the email will send WITHOUT the download button (PDF still attached). Minor hardening: log a warning when public_base is empty.

mailer._send_once (mailer.py:254-273): atomic claim via find_one_and_update on `flag:{\$ne:true}` is correct — ensures the email is sent at most once per flag. On attachment-build failure (contract_attachment raises), it logs but keeps the flag true -> would mark 'sent' without sending. BUT: send_email() happens after that, and if send_email returns False the flag is reset. So if attachment-build fails but email send succeeds (without attachment), the user misses the PDF. Low risk — contract_attachment only fails if the PDF renderer bombs on malformed data.

contract_pdf.build_contract_pdf (contract_pdf.py:52-101): section 1 renders customer fields via _grid; _it(c['birth_date']) converts ISO -> DD/MM/YYYY. The 'Ente e Scadenza' row prints as-entered (user types free text like 'Comune di Tolentino, 31/12/2030' per the placeholder) — no server-side validation of the expiry date. The acceptance block prints _ts(bk['contract_accepted_at']) in Europe/Rome (DD/MM/YYYY alle HH:MM:SS). Verified end-to-end in the PDF text extraction.

frontend/CustomerForm.tsx:74: tax_code is uppercased ONLY on input (not on prefill from GET /api/me/customer). If a user previously typed lowercase, backend already stored uppercase (server strips but doesn't upper), so this is only an issue for migrated data. Non-blocking.

frontend/CustomerForm.tsx:31: toIsoDate rejects birth_date in the future (`dt > new Date()`) and before 1900. Backend only enforces the YYYY-MM-DD shape — a 1899 date would pass server validation. Frontend blocks the submit which is good enough.

frontend/checkout.tsx:65-69: confirm() short-circuits on `!customerOk` BEFORE POSTing /api/bookings; this is the behaviour verified in the UI test (no booking created even with contract accepted). Note confirm-booking-button is NOT disabled on invalid customer — it's enabled, taps go through confirm(), and the function itself returns early + sets showCustErrors=true. UX: a user may wonder why the button 'did nothing'; the error toast + red borders mitigate this. Fine as-is.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (12/12 checks: customer-form present; all 12 field testIDs present; full_name prefilled; nationality default 'Italiana'; tax_code auto-uppercase; birth_date placeholder GG/MM/AAAA; customer-form-error hidden initially; error visible AFTER invalid confirm with correct text; red border on invalid fields (rgb(224,53,43)); no booking created; contract flow still works end-to-end to the point of valid-customer confirm)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created ephemeral TEST_ prefixed data only: (a) session-scoped `TEST_user_<hex>@example.com` from conftest.user_token (reused across the live-HTTPS rejection tests; teardown cancels any pending bookings — none existed because every POST was rejected pre-insert); (b) module-scoped `TEST_iter16_<hex>@example.com` from inproc_setup — the fixture teardown deletes the created booking AND the user directly from Mongo before yielding; (c) one `TEST_iter16_other_<hex>@example.com` created inside test_other_user_gets_404 — deleted in that test's finally; (d) frontend run created 2 `TEST_iter16_fe_<hex>@example.com` users with NO bookings (confirm with valid data never tapped). Post-run cleanup script deleted 3 remaining iter16 users + 0 bookings. Final state: 0 iter16 users, 0 iter16 bookings. (59 older TEST_* users and 19 older TEST_* bookings from previous iterations exist in Mongo; outside this iteration's scope.) Real Google Sheet NOT touched: on_booking_confirmed was monkeypatched to a no-op throughout, so neither push_booking nor the Resend send_email ran. Admin & real Raymon bikes untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter16_customer_pdf.py -n 0 -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iter16.xml` (serial; the in-process ASGI tests use a module-scoped event loop so motor's AsyncIOMotorClient stays bound). ~2.5s runtime. KEY DETAILS: (1) The whole module uses `pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio(loop_scope='module')` + a module-scoped `monkeymodule` fixture — do NOT add `@pytest.mark.asyncio` on individual tests (that overrides loop_scope back to function and triggers 'attached to a different loop' errors against motor). (2) pypdf must be installed (`pip install pypdf`); it's needed for PDF text extraction. (3) Dependencies verified: httpx 0.28.1, PyJWT 2.15.1, motor, pytest-asyncio 1.4.0, requests. (4) Email comparison is case-insensitive because /api/auth/register lowercases the stored email. (5) Server imports trigger startup() which runs sheet-sync/reminder loops — harmless noise. (6) Frontend: localStorage['auth_token'] MUST be JSON.stringify(token); check that iter 15 note is still accurate — it is. SAFETY (unchanged across iterations): NEVER tap confirm-booking-button in the UI with VALID customer+contract (writes to the user's REAL Google Sheet via push_booking + mailer); never POST a complete valid booking against the LIVE HTTPS endpoint from Playwright. For the full happy path, use the httpx.ASGITransport pattern in test_iter16_customer_pdf.py with server.on_booking_confirmed monkeypatched. If future changes add server-side regex to CustomerIn.tax_code (currently only min/max_length), the 422 test will still pass (SHORT fails min_length). The PDF text test is anchored on 'Mario Rossi' + 'RSSMRA80A01L191X' + 'ACCETTAZIONE ELETTRONICA IN APP' — if any of those strings change in contract_pdf.py, update the test.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all specified behaviours work end-to-end. Minor test-harness notes: (1) pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 requires `pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio(loop_scope='module')` at module level AND `@pytest_asyncio.fixture(scope='module', loop_scope='module')` on async fixtures to keep motor's AsyncIOMotorClient on the same loop as the tests (otherwise all post-fixture motor calls fail with 'Future attached to a different loop'). Individual `@pytest.mark.asyncio` test decorators silently override pytestmark back to function-scoped loop — must be removed. (2) Confirm-booking-button on checkout.tsx is also gated on `phoneOk` (phone.replace(/\D/g,'').length>=6), so the Playwright test fills checkout-phone-input to '3331234567' before tapping — otherwise the button is disabled and the invalid-customer path never fires. (3) The outbound registration from Playwright used page.evaluate fetch (same-origin) because urllib from the automation runner hits a 403 on the preview host.
